therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Crohn's disease patients who did not show a clinical effect in the parent double-blind study (NCT00291668)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of CDAI responders at Week 34

results.effect_size: CDAI response rate at Week 34: 66.7% (prior placebo arm), 28.6% (prior CZP 200 mg arm), 42.9% (prior CZP 400 mg arm)
results.target_engagement_evidence: CRP levels declined from baseline across all arms following re-induction with CZP 400 mg (geometric mean CRP ratios <1.0 at most timepoints through Week 34)
biomarker_changes: CRP geometric mean at Week 0: 19.58 mg/L (placebo arm), 14.97 mg/L (CZP 200 mg arm), 26.45 mg/L (CZP 400 mg arm)
CRP geometric mean at Week 34: 9.19 mg/L (placebo arm), 6.23 mg/L (CZP 200 mg arm), 23.52 mg/L (CZP 400 mg arm)
CRP ratio Week 34/Week 0: 0.54 (placebo arm), 0.39 (CZP 200 mg arm), 1.07 (CZP 400 mg arm)
subgroup_findings: At Week 14 (end of re-induction), 100% of subjects in all three arms achieved CDAI response
At Week 34, subjects who had received placebo in the main study had the highest CDAI response rate (66.7%) after re-induction with CZP 400 mg
Remission rates at Week 34: 33.3% (prior placebo), 28.6% (prior CZP 200 mg), 42.9% (prior CZP 400 mg)
70-point response rates at Week 34: 66.7% (prior placebo), 42.9% (prior CZP 200 mg), 42.9% (prior CZP 400 mg)
Number of subjects with disease progression (Week 14–34): 1 per arm
safety_signals: Pulmonary tuberculosis reported as SAE in CZP 400 mg / CZP 400 mg arm (1/15)
Suicide attempt reported as SAE in CZP 400 mg / CZP 400 mg arm (1/15)
Psychotic disorder reported as SAE in CZP 400 mg / CZP 400 mg arm (1/15)
Perianal abscess reported as SAE in CZP 400 mg / Placebo arm (1/18)
Crohn's disease exacerbation as SAE in CZP 200 mg and CZP 400 mg arms

dose_info.schedule: subcutaneous at Weeks 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32 (relative to main study start)

context.comparator: No separate comparator; all arms received CZP 400 mg re-induction; arms differ by prior treatment in parent study (placebo, CZP 200 mg, or CZP 400 mg)
context.duration: 26 weeks (extension study); 34 weeks total from main study start

subgroups.raw_descriptor: Percentage of subjects not in remission

results_by_chain.population_description: Crohn's disease patients who received placebo in the parent double-blind study and did not achieve clinical response, subsequently re-induced with CZP 400 mg
Crohn's disease patients who received CZP 200 mg in the parent double-blind study and did not achieve clinical response, subsequently re-induced with CZP 400 mg
Crohn's disease patients who received CZP 400 mg in the parent double-blind study and did not achieve clinical response, subsequently re-induced with CZP 400 mg
